label: The replay refusal is live: --score on the 54-row fixture printed 42 replay-refused (route) rows, then rows: 54 labeled=12 operator=12 committed_gold=0, then stop: fewer than 30 labeled rows (12 labeled), exit 0. The refusal runs before any model call and matches the 049 record (12 of 54 at HEAD). The fixture keep is historical; the current build cannot reach the keep rule.

The power wall: one-sided sign-test 80% power needs 158 discordant pairs at a 0.60 win rate, 69 at 0.65, 37 at 0.70; the fixture held 21. At the fixture's 21/54 discordant rate, 69 pairs need ~177 clarify rows, i.e. ~32,000 committed prompts at today's 2-per-365 mode rate. The keep rule compares against the first alternative while always-none scores 34/54 against Jev's 28; the strongest simple policy is printed but not required to be beaten. A live-win proof needs shadow-collected real rows plus class floors and a strongest-policy bar.
sources: command: exact binomial sign-test power from fixture counts (W=17 L=4 of 54)

label: The 049 trust upgrades landed: report.json records rows/labels/options/scorer digests and build identity; class and hub results print with first/second/always-none/strongest baselines; label approver and decision reference are accepted; the early stop (two agreeing orders, third only on disagreement) matched all 54 recorded modal picks in 118 calls against 163. Tests grew 22 to 31.

The seam is confirmed dropped: the engine decision carries decision.clarify.alternatives (the scorer and census read it directly), but the normalized runtime route returns only {hubId, action, selectionKind, targets, effectivePolicyHash, generation} with targets empty on clarify, and resolveRoute serves only that identity-bound shape. A served suggestion needs a routing-owner contract extension first; gold_in_alternatives=0 in every census cell shows the alternatives rarely even contain the gold.

Integration shape: add 'clarify-default' with env JEV_FEATURE_CLARIFY_DEFAULT to FEATURES and an advisory call site beside action: clarify that suggests one alternative, never replaces the clarification, and fails open on none_of_these, timeout, error, missing credentials or a generation mismatch. Prerequisites: a named reader and scope amendment, shadow logging first (T1), and a payload decision.

Tests to cover beyond the landed refusal/replay/digest/early-stop cases: a shadow-log capture test (user pick as label), a normalized-route alternatives contract test, class-floor assertions (named-mode accuracy plus abstention precision/recall), a strongest-policy-bar verdict case, and a --transcripts end-to-end clarify-rate test (the path exists but was never run).
